title: PCE Report Shows Consumer Prices Rose Slightly in September
content: The most recent Personal Consumption Expenditures index was delayed because of the government shutdown.

title: Savings Accounts for Disabled People Are Expanding. Do You Qualify?
content: Starting next year, people who became disabled by age 46 will be eligible to open ABLE accounts. The accounts have been slow to catch on, partly because the current age limit is 26.

title: The Markets Are Temperamental. Understand Your Risks.
content: Shifting expectations of a Fed rate cut reflect underlying uncertainty about politics and the economy. Here are some essentials for managing risk in investing.

title: New York Times Sues A.I. Start-Up Perplexity Over Use of Copyrighted Work
content: Filed in federal court on Friday, the suit joins more than 40 other court disputes between copyright holders and A.I. companies.

title: Why the Battle for Warner Bros. Discovery May Not Be Over Yet
content: Netflix struck a deal to buy one of Hollywood’s most storied studios. But a scorned rival, and the Trump administration, may put up a fight.

title: India’s IndiGo Airline Falls Into Chaos, Canceling About 1,000 Flights
content: IndiGo, which controls nearly two-thirds of the domestic market, blamed the disruption on weather, tech systems and rules about rest for crew members. Pilots said the company was cutting corners.

title: How Scammers Target Older Americans With Fraudulent Medicare Calls
content: Complaints about the calls have risen, and some older Americans have discovered that their Medicare accounts were already compromised.

title: How Batteries Got Cheaper and Made the Electric Grid More Reliable
content: An early grid battery was installed in the Atacama Desert in Chile 15 years ago. Now, as prices have tumbled, they are increasingly being used around the world.

title: Netflix to Buy Warner Bros in $83 Billion Deal
content: The deal to acquire the Hollywood behemoth’s television and film studios as well as HBO Max will bulk up the world’s biggest paid streaming service.

title: Stellantis Is in Default for Moving Jeep Production to U.S., Canada Says
content: The automaker switched production from Ontario in a bid to please President Trump. But the company defaulted on contracts covering hundreds of millions of dollars in assistance, Canada said.

title: Faulty Glucose Monitor Sensors May Be Tied to 7 Deaths, F.D.A. Says
content: Abbott Diabetes Care said it had received reports of more than 700 injuries that may be associated with malfunctioning sensors.

title: Groups Express Anixety as Trump Threatens to Derail U.S.-Mexico-Canada Trade Pact
content: Hearings that began Wednesday in Washington reflected anxiety over the future of the U.S.-Mexico-Canada trade pact and whether the president could end up scrapping it.

title: Newsom, Kirk, A.I., Trump and Other DealBook Summit Highlights
content: The economy, inflation, tariffs, bubble fears, crypto and other big topics that made headlines this year.

title: Harvey, a Maker of A.I. Legal Software, Raises $160 Million
content: The start-up is now valued at about $8 billion as it pushes to add new customers, including those outside law firms.

title: But Who Is the Snake in ‘Zootopia 2’?
content: Gary Goldman, who has battled Disney in court over the franchise, thinks the viper Gary De’Snake is based on him.
